name: Hartanah Kenyalang Berhad
overview: 2026年，Hartanah Kenyalang Berhad 的业务板块没有在公告中披露新的合约、扩张或退出动作；公司完成了多笔新股发行融资，并派发了2025财年的中期股息。最新一季（截至2026年7月31日）营收同比增长64.6%，净利润同比增长126.5%。
overview_en: In 2026, Hartanah Kenyalang Berhad did not disclose any new contracts, expansions, or exits for its business segments in its announcements; the company completed several new share issuances and paid an interim dividend for FY2025. For the latest quarter ended 31 July 2026, revenue grew 64.6% year-on-year and net profit grew 126.5% year-on-year.
